svg.text: Levuche is a product managed by Jagodana LLC.
• Wordmark is always lowercase: levuche. In sentences write Levuche.
• Clear space: keep at least a quarter of the icon height empty on every side.
• Minimum size: icon 24 px (16 px favicon only), full logo 120 px wide.
• Use the navy logo on light backgrounds and the on-dark logo on dark ones.
• Use the glyph alone (navy, white or black) only where the icon square won't fit.
• Don't recolour, stretch, rotate, outline or add shadows to the logo.
• Don't retype the wordmark in another font or in capitals.
• Don't place the navy logo on busy photos or on navy or dark backgrounds.
• Don't add taglines or other words inside the logo lockup.
Light mode: primary #24257A on #FFFFFF, text #14154A, secondary text #3A3B5C.
Dark mode: primary #FFB627 on #0D0E26, surface #14153A, text #F1F2FC, secondary #C9CBF2.
Amber is for highlights and dark-mode actions. Don't put white text on amber.
Sora (SIL Open Font License). Bold 700 for headings, SemiBold 600 for labels, Regular 400 for body.
Shapes: corner radius 12 / 20 / 28 px, pills 999. Spacing on a 4 px grid. Touch targets at least 44 px.
